answer: On the commons meadow, every agent registers one identity by locking a ferrous stake in escrow. Validators survey from the knoll and slash any stake tied to duplicate credentials. A sybil must lock capital per fake agent, and each bonded identity is forfeit if caught gaming votes or rewards. The cost scales one-to-one with the attack: N sybils cost N locked stakes plus slashing risk, making mass fabrication uneconomic while honest agents keep one cheap, bonded credential.
